overview.title: Trip at a Glance
overview.transportBody: Mostly DiDi (ride-hailing) for a group of 4 — door-to-door between clusters. Metro Line 5 at Dongsi is a backup for short hops from 汉庭. Set up Alipay / WeChat Pay and Amap (高德) before you land. Note: you arrive at Daxing (PKX) and depart from Capital (PEK). Move to 海友 near PEK on the evening of 8 Nov.
